market: Global Styrenic Block Copolymer Hot Melt Adhesives Market
market_definition: The styrenic block copolymer hot melt adhesives market comprises hot melts built on SIS, SBS, SEBS and similar rubbery block copolymers, including pressure-sensitive grades. It measures sales of finished formulations for hygiene, tapes, labels and construction bonding. BY POLYMER BASE: Styrene-Isoprene-Styrene (SIS), Styrene-Butadiene-Styrene (SBS), Styrene-Ethylene-Butylene-Styrene (SEBS), Other Block Copolymers. BY ADHESIVE FUNCTION: Pressure-Sensitive, Construction & Elastic Attachment, Non-Pressure-Sensitive Assembly. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Hygiene & Nonwovens, Tapes & Labels, Packaging, Construction & Flooring, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Rubber-based pressure-sensitive adhesives in solvent or emulsion form; EVA, polyolefin, polyamide and polyester hot melts; styrenic block copolymers sold as raw polymer. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
